lines.text: CoopTracker. Cooperative finance, without the spreadsheets.
One place for members, loans and dividends, always reconciled.
The dashboard shows the whole co-op, and who has paid this period.
Mark collections, and see each member's shares and capital.
Follow every loan to the last peso, then share out the interest.
The interest pool, divided by every eligible share.
Computed, not guessed, and tested before it's saved.
CoopTracker. Designed and built by Keith Vergara.
